items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And meanwhile, [in] Beppu I saw this dance hall...

ctx.x: No, actually, my parents wanted me to go to medical school. But we got back to Japan in July—I don‟t quite remember, fourteenth or fifteenth, I think, middle of July anyway—and I mentioned earlier that the Japanese school starts [in the] spring, so I had a few months. And meanwhile, [in] Beppu I saw this dance hall, they had a flier pasted on the window saying “Pianist wanted.” So I went in because … I knew my parents no longer could furnish me with a piano, it was that kind of condition.
